besluite.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'Die Aarde beweeg' and 'die ander planete doen' each have their own subject and verb, so the AWS requires the comma.

besluite.fout: two verbs 'beweeg vorm' collide and make the reader stumble
besluite.rede: The AWS allows a comma between adjacent verbs for clarity, and it marks where the subject ends without changing anything.

besluite.fout: missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses
besluite.rede: 'party is groot ronde wereelde' and 'party is baie klein' are two clauses with their own subject and verb.
'hoor jy iemand se daar is nege planete' is natural spoken Afrikaans; the 'dat' version is longer and pushes the verb to the end without being clearly better.

besluite.fout: Pluto is 'hom' in one sentence and 'dit' in the next
besluite.rede: Making the pronoun 'hy' matches the preceding 'hom' and removes the inconsistent reference without changing the claim.

besluite.rede: 'Dit beweeg heeltyd' and 'dit volg ... dieselfde pad' each have their own subject and verb.

besluite.rede: 'Die Aarde beweeg nooit terug nie' and 'die beweging hou nooit op nie' are two full clauses.
'Een volle reis om die son neem die Aarde ongeveer een jaar' is idiomatic Afrikaans, while 'neem ... vir' copies English 'takes a year for'.

besluite.rede: 'beteken' states the same link precisely and naturally, with the time, count and 'dus' intact.
